exposure: placental abnormalities (e.g., placenta previa, accreta, increta, percreta)
cohort: Antenatal subjects with a history of previous lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) presenting to a tertiary medical college in central India.
finding: Placental abnormalities, including placenta accreta, increta, and percreta, were significantly associated with adverse neonatal outcomes such as preterm deliveries.
cross-section timing: Data was collected on antenatal subjects during their pregnancy, and feto-maternal outcomes were studied throughout their postnatal period.
